PP_LibEditDropHere: Drag an image here or press "Choose..."
PP_LibEditImagesHint: PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF or ICO. For the icon you can also choose a .exe. "Default" goes back to the original image (Steam or the game's .exe).
PP_LibEditLaunchHint: Steam and Epic games start through their launcher (steam://, com.epicgames.launcher://). Change it only if the game does not start.
PP_LibEditBadImage: That file is not an image PhantomPad can show (use PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF or ICO).
PP_LibEditBadYear: The year must be a number like 2008.
